stem:
The chlorides of some of the Period 3 elements are shown in Table 2.1.

**Table 2.1**

| Period 3 chloride | $\text{NaCl}$ | $\text{AlCl}_3$ | $\text{SiCl}_4$ | $\text{PCl}_5$ | $\text{PCl}_3$ | $\text{SCl}_2$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| bonding |  |  |  |  | C | C |
| structure |  |  |  |  | S | S |
| oxidation state of Period 3 element |  |  |  |  |  |  |

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete Table 2.1.

- Identify the bonding shown by each chloride under standard conditions. Use C = covalent, I = ionic, M = metallic.

- Identify the structure shown by each chloride under standard conditions. Use G = giant, S = simple.

- Deduce the oxidation state of the Period 3 element in each chloride.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Write equations for the reactions of $\text{NaCl}$ and $\text{PCl}_5$ with water. Include state symbols in both equations.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
In the gas phase, $\text{AlCl}_3\text{(g)}$ exists at equilibrium with $\text{Al}_2\text{Cl}_6\text{(g)}$ as shown.

equation **1** $$2\text{AlCl}_3\text{(g)} \rightleftharpoons \text{Al}_2\text{Cl}_6\text{(g)} \quad \Delta H_{\text{r}} = -63\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
Complete the dot-and-cross diagram to show the bonding in $\text{Al}_2\text{Cl}_6$.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: State the effect of an increase in temperature on the equilibrium mixture in equation **1**. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
A $3.30\text{ g}$ sample of a Period 3 chloride is heated to $500\text{ K}$ in a sealed flask. At this temperature, the chloride is a gas of volume $250\text{ cm}^3$ and the pressure in the flask is $323\text{ kPa}$.

Use the ideal gas equation $pV = nRT$ to calculate the $M_{\text{r}}$ of the Period 3 chloride. Deduce its formula.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.text:
An excess of $\text{Cl}^-\text{(aq)}$ is added to $1\text{ cm}^3$ of $\text{Br}_2\text{(aq)}$.

Describe what is observed. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text:
$\text{SCl}_2$ has $M_{\text{r}} = 103.1$ and is a liquid at room temperature. $\text{SBr}_2$ has $M_{\text{r}} = 191.9$ and is a gas at room temperature.

Explain the difference in the physical state of $\text{SCl}_2$ and $\text{SBr}_2$. Give your answer in terms of intermolecular forces.

parts.label: (f)
parts.stem: Bismuth is a dense metal in the same group as phosphorus.

parts.label: (f)(i)
parts.text: Draw a labelled diagram to show the bonding in bismuth metal.

parts.label: (f)(ii)
parts.text:
Bismuth reacts with chlorine to form $\text{BiCl}_3$. $\text{BiCl}_3$ is a solid at room temperature. It melts when heated gently. $\text{BiCl}_3$ reacts vigorously with water at room temperature to form an acidic solution.

Suggest the type of bonding and structure shown by $\text{BiCl}_3$. Explain your answer.
